name: What is involved in fence stability restoration?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in fence stability restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fence stability restoration typically involves assessing the damage, repairing or replacing compromised posts, reinforcing weak sections, tightening fasteners, and sometimes addressing soil erosion around the fence line. For wooden fences, this might mean replacing rotted post sections or adding concrete support. For metal fences, it could involve welding repairs or replacing bent components. The specific steps depend on the type of fence and the extent of the instability.
